name: Orientation Year permit (Zoekjaar)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being a graduate of a Dutch program, a PhD/research completion in the Netherlands, a graduate of a top-200 ranked international university (master's minimum for foreign graduates), or a former Highly Skilled Migrant.
This must be applied for within 3 years of graduation, PhD completion, or research completion.

evidence_required.document: Degree certificate or PhD/research completion confirmation

sources.title: Residence permit for orientation year - IND

notes: No sponsor, no salary threshold, full unrestricted work rights and may start a business — the most unrestricted route in this dataset alongside UK Global Talent and Germany's Chancenkarte (recognised-qualification path), but genuinely simpler than either since it requires no points and no funds test to sponsor family during the year. Fee €254 confirmed via ind.nl; €85 for Turkish nationals (Association Agreement standstill rights), free for San Marino/Israel — a genuinely unusual three-tier fee structure worth flagging. This route's real value isn't itself — it's unlocking the reduced HSM (€3,122) and reduced Blue Card (€4,754) salary thresholds for up to 3 years after the qualifying graduation/PhD/research event, which is why leads_to_pr is false but switchable_to is heavily populated. One-time and non-renewable: someone who used it once cannot use it again even if they later requalify.
